ledger.x: 1776 (1 August): the Viceroyalty of the Rio de la Plata is organised.
1777 (1 October): the Treaty of San Ildefonso confirms Colonia del Sacramento.
1777 (1 October): Spain gives up Santa Catalina and Rio Grande in the same treaty.
1801 (War of the Oranges): Portugal takes the Misiones Orientales.
1806 (June): a British force takes Buenos Aires.
1807 (28 June): the second British invasion begins at the Rio de la Plata.
1810: Upper Peru is annexed to the Viceroyalty of Peru.
1810 (25 May): the Primera Junta takes Buenos Aires and the Provinces.

wars.name: War of the Oranges (Misiones Orientales)
wars.outcome: Portugal took the Misiones Orientales and never returned them.

wars.name: British invasions of the Río de la Plata
wars.outcome: Beresford held Buenos Aires for 46 days in 1806; Whitelocke surrendered on 7 July 1807.

wars.name: Banda Oriental campaign and siege of Montevideo
wars.outcome: Artigas's uprising (Cry of Asencio, 28 February 1811), the Treaty of Pacification (21 October 1811), the siege reestablished on 20 October 1812 and Vigodet's surrender on 17 May 1814.

certainty.note: Frontiers with Portuguese Brazil follow the 1777 Treaty of San Ildefonso for Colonia and San Gabriel; the Chaco and Patagonia limits are undefined.
The royalist rump after 1810 is a besieged city, not a frontier.
